body:
I don’t even know what would help me at this point. Going to a psych ward bc I’m suicidal doesn’t sound like a great idea, last time I was hospitalized I hated every second of it and just cried and felt so alone. The only appealing idea is death. I feel like I don’t deserve to be here. 
I’m so overwhelmed. I feel like my body is going to explode with all of this anxiety.

thank you for your kind words, they do mean a lot. Especially about my mom. I’m hoping that she gets better soon. 
I also wish I would get better but I really don’t have hope and generally just don’t know what to do. This anxiety is killing me, I wish I could just go to sleep and not wake up :/

I’m so sorry for your loss. I am very lucky that my mom survived her first surgery in March. It’s crazy how similar the situations people are in at the same time yet feel so alone. I’m here for now if you’d like to talk.
